title: Method for making laminated cushioning material
abstract: Method for fusing plastic film layers without adhesives to create laminated cushioning material. One film is heated and molded into discrete cells using a female roller with vacuum molding. A second heated film is then applied to hermetically seal the cells, creating sealed air pockets that provide cushioning and shock absorption.
gist: Bubble wrap: one heated plastic film is vacuum-formed into cells on a roller, then a second heated film is fused on top to seal air into each cell — no adhesive needed.
